d: Apartments of the Marquis with tables above which there are some clothes of his service. The Marquis, Valerio, Lauretta, and other Servitators, who serve the Marquis.
Count Lelio, Camilla, followed by Hunters, Rosinella in the background.
Apartment of the Marquis. The Marquis, and Camilla, then Rosinella with noble dress. Servants.
The Marquis, then Count Lelio with Pasqualino.
Rosinella, Valerio, and Lauretta, then Pasqualino in other dress.
Loggias corresponding to the garden. The Marquis, and Valerio.
The Marquis, then Camilla, and Lauretta.
Camilla, and Lauretta, then the Count.
The Marquis with book in hand, and sayings.
Room with four practical doors. Camilla, Lauretta with light in her hand; then the Count on her door; then Rosinella, and the Marquis preceded by a servant with light.
Pasqualino, then Camilla from his door.
The Marquis, then Pasqualino with Camilla, then Rosinella with the Count.
Apartment of the Marquis. Pasqualino, then the Marquis.
